svg.aria-label: What I build: Full-stack & integrations: Next.js and React on Node.js or FastAPI, with auth, payments, webhooks and third-party APIs wired in.; Mobile apps: Native Android apps in Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, plus mobile-first web apps tested from 375 px up.; Bots & automation: Telegram bots with multi-language menus, live data feeds and scheduled jobs that run on their own.; AI agents & LLMs: Assistants and tool-calling agents on Claude, OpenAI and Gemini, with rate limits and fallbacks.; Computer vision: License-plate recognition for gate control, plus face and hand tracking at 30+ FPS in the browser.; Machine learning: Uzbek speech recognition research: own dataset, a CNN-CTC baseline, Wav2Vec2 and Whisper.
